visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with pigtails sits on a wooden floor indoors, looking intently at several small white cards with floral drawings held by an adult's hands. The setting is bright with natural light from a nearby window. (2) The camera zooms in as the girl selects a card. She wears a white T-shirt with a black cat graphic and plaid shorts. Her hands are small, and her expression is focused. (3) The girl applies a temporary tattoo to an adult's forearm. She presses the card down with her fingers. A pink wet towel is then placed over her hand to dampen the tattoo. (4) The towel is lifted, revealing a delicate black ink-style floral tattoo on the adult's pale skin. The girl watches with anticipation. (5) The girl moves to another 'customer,' a woman sitting on the floor. She picks a new floral card from the pile on the wooden floor. (6) The girl carefully applies the tattoo to the woman's lower leg, using the pink towel again with a serious, professional demeanor. (7) A younger toddler in a pink shirt enters the frame, touching and trying to peel a tattoo already placed on the woman's leg. The background shows home bookshelves. (8) The older girl approaches a man standing nearby, asking him to extend his hand. She applies a large floral tattoo to the center of his palm. (9) The man reacts with a wide-eyed expression of surprise as the tattoo is revealed. The girl smiles broadly, showing her teeth. (10) The girl returns to the pile of cards, picking one for herself and asking for help to put it on her own arm. (11) She shows off her new arm tattoo to the camera, beaming with joy. (12) The video ends with a simple cartoon animation of a boy and girl on a yellow background with text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody in a major key. A child's high-pitched voice enthusiastically explains picking a tattoo. (2) Soft rustling of paper is audible as cards are moved. An adult female voice responds with a warm, encouraging tone. (3) A sequence of brief, energetic vocal exclamations from adults follows each 'tattoo application,' creating a sense of playful excitement. (4) Distinct vocal shift occurs as the child commands a 'customer' to extend their hand; the tone is authoritative yet cute. (5) A man's voice enters with a surprised 'Woo~' followed by a deep-toned laugh. (6) The BGM remains consistent throughout, providing a joyful rhythmic bed. Final segment features multiple voices saying 'So beautiful' in a harmonic, high-valence peak before a short animated jingle ends the track.
